program.name: rpsbproc
program.description: Process output from offline rpsblast to annotate sequence with conserved domain information
program.detailed_description: This utility processes domain hit data produced by local RPS-BLAST and generates domain family and/or superfamily annotations on the query sequences. Instead of retrieving domain data from database, this program processes dumped datafiles to obtain required information. All data files are downloadable from NCBI ftp site. Read README file for details

key.name: d
key.description: Specify directory that contains data files. By default, the program will look in 'data' directory in current directory and the directory where the program is located

key.name: e
key.description: EValue cut-off. Program will only process hits with evalues better than this value.

key.name: i
key.description: Input file(s) that holds asn data produced by rpsblast with "-outfmt 11" switch. If omitted, default to stdin.

key.name: logfile
key.description: File to which the program log should be redirected

key.name: m
key.description: Select redundancy level of domain hit data. Valid options are "rep" (concise), "std"(standard) and "full" (all hits). Default to "rep"

key.name: o
key.description: Output file to write the processed result. If omitted, default to stdout.

key.name: t
key.description: Target data: Select desired (target) data. Valid options are "doms", "feats" or "both". . If omitted, default to "both"

flag.name: dryrun
flag.description: Dry run the application: do nothing, only test all preconditions

flag.name: f
flag.description: When specified, show corresponding superfamily information for domain hits.

flag.name: h
flag.description: Print USAGE and DESCRIPTION; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: help
flag.description: Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: q
flag.description: Quiet mode -- do not display program information and progress on stderr

flag.name: version
flag.description: Print version number; ignore other arguments

flag.name: version-full
flag.description: Print extended version data; ignore other arguments

flag.name: version-full-json
flag.description: Print extended version data in JSON format; ignore other arguments

flag.name: version-full-xml
flag.description: Print extended version data in XML format; ignore other arguments

flag.name: xmlhelp
flag.description: Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS in XML format; ignore all other parameters
